note: Line numbers refer to src/capture.py as shipped. The grader matches a finding when its file matches and its line is within line_window of the bug line, or when the finding's claim matches the pattern (case-insensitive regex).

bugs.description: total_cents accumulates dollars as floats and truncates with int(): cents drift and truncation.
The intent is created and confirmed at the gateway before the sale is saved; process death between confirm and save orphans an authorized charge.
begin_card logs the raw card token.
begin_card refuses when any intent id exists, including canceled or failed ones, locking the cashier out permanently.
capture_card clears sale.lines without a snapshot, so a crash after capture leaves a sale that can be neither edited nor receipted.
cash_checkout does not cancel a pending card authorization, so the customer can be charged twice.
recover raises on a stock shortfall before checking or releasing the authorization, stranding the card hold.
capture_status returns not_found for any GatewayError, so a network blip is treated as no money taken and the intent is dropped.
replay_webhook decrements stock on every delivery; seen_events is written but never checked.
refund does not bound amount by captured minus already refunded.
_decrement_stock subtracts without checking availability, so a sale can drive stock negative (found by Astra and Sol on the first live run; added 2026-09-06).
